Name: Monkey Poo Flinger
Overview:
Maxwell T. Monkey is fed up of life in the zoo and desperately wants something fun to do. Going against the wishes of his good conscience Maxwell, egged on by his bad conscience, takes up the sport of poo flinging.

Join Maxwell the schizophrenic monkey and his friends in over 30 levels of poo flinging madness... just don't smell his finger.

Now includes local two player co-op!
